edges.notes: libc++abi provides Itanium C++ ABI routines linked alongside libc++ in typical Clang -stdlib=libc++ deployments.
Clang-generated C++ object files reference libc++abi symbols for exceptions, RTTI, and static initialization.
lld resolves libc++abi when linking libc++-using binaries in LLVM toolchains.
libc++abi uses C library and pthread-layer services on GNU/Linux hosted builds.
Clang + libc++/libc++abi stacks can target musl Linux with a consistent sysroot.
libc++abi uses C library and threading services from FreeBSD libc on FreeBSD-hosted Clang builds.
libc++abi uses C library and threading services from OpenBSD libc on OpenBSD-hosted Clang builds.
libc++abi uses C library and threading services from NetBSD libc on NetBSD-hosted Clang builds.
libc++abi uses C library and threading services from DragonFly libc on DragonFly-hosted Clang builds.
libc++abi uses C library and threading services from illumos libc on illumos-hosted Clang builds.
libc++abi uses C library and threading services from Bionic on Android NDK libc++ builds.
libc++abi may use C services from newlib in embedded libc++ configurations when toolchains align.
libc++abi may pair with libc++ on wasm WASI targets backed by wasi-libc.
libc++abi may pair with libc++ on uClibc embedded Linux targets when packaging matches.
libc++abi may pair with libc++ on dietlibc minimal Linux targets when packaging matches.
GNU ld can link libc++abi objects when Clang is not using lld.
libc++abi is packaged as ELF shared objects on typical Unix targets.
Exception handling and debug info interact with DWARF unwind data on ELF targets.
C++ ABI runtime bridges compiler-generated code with C/POSIX runtime underneath.
GDB debugs through exception frames and RTTI metadata produced with libc++abi in the link.
LLDB debugs Clang + libc++/libc++abi stacks natively on LLVM-oriented targets.
LLVM ships libc++abi for RISC-V targets alongside libc++ in LLVM toolchains.
